notes: The Section 6 duty is the main lever for SI3, nature recovery in public services; weak compliance and unclear scope are known gaps, and the third-round reports plus oversight by the new environmental governance body are the next evidence to watch.
summary: On 16 September 2025 the Welsh Government published its response to the evaluation of the Section 6 biodiversity and resilience of ecosystems duty, which had found public authorities unsure whether they were in scope and 38 authorities that did not respond to the review. Following an Audit Wales study, it said it now proposed to publish a list of in-scope authorities, would have the Cabinet Secretary remind authorities that their third round of reports was due at the end of 2025, and pointed to the planned Office of Environmental Governance Wales overseeing compliance. A guide to what counts as a Section 6 public authority followed on 18 December 2025, and the third reporting round closed on 31 December 2025.
title: Welsh Government responds to the Section 6 biodiversity duty evaluation, proposing to publish which public authorities are in scope
